title: resasm verification job (v1)
description: One file that describes a residual-assembly verification against an Abaqus run. Consumed by `resasm verify-job`.

name.description: OPTIONAL label for the run and its report.

model.description: Path to the Abaqus .inp (or a neutral .json). Provides the mesh and boundary conditions. Resolved relative to the job file.

odb.description: Path to the solved .odb. The tool runs `abaqus python scripts/extract_odb_fields.py` once to export S (integration-point stress), RF (reactions) and U (displacements). Needs Abaqus on this machine.

fields.description: Path to an already-exported fields.json (stress_ip / reactions / displacements). Use INSTEAD of 'odb' when Abaqus is not on this machine (offline path).

mode.description: Assembly mode. 'stress-driven' rebuilds the residual from the exported integration-point stress with no material update.

compare_reactions.description: Compare the assembled reaction at prescribed DOFs to the Abaqus RF (up to one global sign).

tol.description: Relative tolerance for the free-residual and reaction-match checks.

output.description: Output directory for the exported fields.json (when 'odb' is used) and verification_report.json.
